final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), benchmark1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean1 FROM per_order), above1 AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_remain, p.avg_remain - b.mean1 AS excess1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN benchmark1 b WHERE p.avg_remain > b.mean1), benchmark2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean2 FROM above1), above2 AS (SELECT a.avg_remain, a.excess1, a.avg_remain - b.mean2 AS excess2 FROM above1 a CROSS JOIN benchmark2 b WHERE a.avg_remain > b.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS remaining_orders_avg, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second FROM above2
